8e9dcc99c8a99977.question: Which policy rules decide this case, and what do they require the handler to do?

answer.answer: This is an irresponsible lending complaint. LND-1 requires handing it to Lending Specialists, and ESC-1 routes it there too. The customer also shows financial difficulty and possible risk to wellbeing ("I can't sleep", "at the end of my rope"). That points to severity High under CH-6 and a referral to Vulnerable Customer Support under VUL-4. VUL-2 requires the handler to ask, sensitively, whether the customer needs support. FEE-4 requires a review of fees from the last 6 months. ESC-2 requires the handover within 2 business days, with all ten ESC-3 fields. The case is At risk, so CH-5 requires weekly team leader review. The file does not show any vulnerability question, referral, handover or contact preference. The outcome and any redress must be decided by an authorised person.
